page.content:
Beans, brewing traditions, and café cultures from origin to specialty.

How Coffee connects

  • Item: Coffea arabica — Arabica is the species behind most specialty and café coffee.
  • Location: Ethiopia — Ethiopia is the genetic and legendary origin of Arabica coffee.
  • Location: Yemen — Yemen was the first long-distance export culture of the coffee trade.
  • Item: Coffea canephora — Robusta is the other commercial coffee species.
  • Item: French press — The French press is a home immersion method for brewing coffee.
  • Location: Viennese coffee house — The Viennese coffee house is a historic European café form.

What is Coffee?

Coffee is the drink and the crop: Coffea arabica from Ethiopian forests, Yemeni mocha on the Red Sea, espresso in Italy, and the third-wave taste for terroir that treats a farm like a vineyard.

Key threads lead to Coffea arabica, Ethiopia, Yemen, Coffea canephora, French press and Viennese coffee house.
